patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Saleor and Tiendanube share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Saleor and Tiendanube share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose Saleor only if your buying job matches “Headless GraphQL commerce — OSS self-host free; Cloud Select $1599/mo, Volume $3999/mo, En” rather than Tiendanube's shape. Choose Tiendanube only if your buying job matches “LATAM hosted commerce (Tiendanube / Nuvemshop brand) — Argentina ARS tiles: Inicial $0, Es” rather than Saleor's shape. Workflow advantage differs because Saleor is shaped for Headless GraphQL commerce — OSS self-host free; Cloud Select $1599/mo, whereas Tiendanube is shaped for LATAM hosted commerce (Tiendanube / Nuvemshop brand) — Argentina ARS t. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Saleor and Tiendanube share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Saleor is Headless GraphQL commerce — OSS self-host free; Cloud Select $1599/mo, Volume $3999/mo, Enterprise quote. Forever Free is non-commercial onl; Tiendanube is LATAM hosted commerce (Tiendanube / Nuvemshop brand) — Argentina ARS tiles: Inicial $0, Esencial ~$20 USD, Impulso ~$59 highlighted, Escala .
- Company-size focus: Saleor (mid-market, enterprise) vs Tiendanube (small-business, mid-market).
- Researched limits: Saleor — Cloud Select floor ($1599/mo) is high versus WooCommerce hosting TCO; Tiendanube — Regional LATAM focus — not a global Shopify peer for every market.

Limitations — Saleor: Cloud Select floor ($1599/mo) is high versus WooCommerce hosting TCO; Forever Free Cloud is non-commercial — not a production merchant free plan; Tiendanube: Regional LATAM focus — not a global Shopify peer for every market; USD amounts are FX approximates; ARS tiles are the source of truth.

Poor-fit cases: Saleor is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Cloud Select floor ($1599/mo) is high versus WooCommerce hosting TCO · Tiendanube is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Regional LATAM focus — not a global Shopify peer for every market · Avoid Saleor if you actually need Tiendanube's motion (LATAM hosted commerce (Tiendanube / Nuvemshop brand) — Argentina ARS tiles: Inic)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
